problem_type: AI canvas reference image discovery omits valid result owners and history
symptom: Asset and edited-image results plus older generated images are absent from the AI reference picker.
direct_cause: DirectorNode filters kind=image and reads only node.result.
class_root: Reference candidates are inferred from node kind instead of the shared image result contract.
affected_population: All canvas image results including asset, edited and historical results
invariants: Every valid image result is selectable independent of node kind
Current result and history do not duplicate the same node URL
Historical references have stable compound identities
generality_proof: All nodes pass through one result-type collector; both current and historical entries use the same validation and deduplication.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Derive all reference images from typed canvas results.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Signature comes from the same collector as the displayed list.
The picker receives current and historical results through one shape.

recurrence.reason: Any asset node or older result can be omitted under the old kind/current-result filter.
same_class_scan: Read DirectorNode current image subscription and projection

prevention.invariant: Result semantics, not producer kind, determine image eligibility.
prevention.failure_mode: Non-image, empty and duplicate results are omitted.
prevention.strategy: Use one collector for the reactive signature and the picker payload.

legacy_paths.rationale: Remove both copies of the image-node-only/current-result projection.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Uses existing typed canvas results; no runtime dependency change.

residual_risks: Reference selection is tested locally; live external AI scene generation requires a configured provider.
internal_only_reason: Canvas image ownership is defined by GenerationNodeResult.type and per-node history. The approved director feature inventory (section 2.6) explicitly includes current and historical images.

invariant_owner_layer.why: 不变量由 src/workbench/generationCanvas/nodes/director/bridge/canvasImages.ts 单点持有（即本合同的 prevention.enforcement_path / shared_boundaries）；上游其它入口只调用它、不各自重判。tests 是该层现有的类级与回归测试，改动这条不变量必先让它们红。
